name: Ring Mail
summary: Heavy armor: AC 14; Disadvantage on Stealth.
text: Heavy armor. While you wear it, your base Armor Class is 14; your Dexterity modifier does not apply. You have Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while wearing it. Putting it on takes 10 minutes and taking it off takes 5 minutes. Without training in Heavy armor, you have Disadvantage on every D20 Test that uses Strength or Dexterity and you can't cast spells.
